title: Comparing Classes and Templates between Dynamics SL and Dynamics 365 Business Central

chapters.title: Creating customers from customer classes in SL
Customer templates in Business Central basics
Configuring posting groups and dimensions in templates
Applying templates to new and existing customers

features.name: Customer classes in Dynamics SL
features.description: Classes group similar customers together for reporting purposes and supply default settings when new records are created, including receivables price class, terms, and GL accounts.
caveats: Feature specific to Dynamics SL, not Business Central

features.name: Customer templates in Business Central
features.description: Templates allow streamlined setup of customers with default values for fields like credit limit, sales person, business posting group, customer posting group, and dimensions.
caveats: Requires personalization to add specific fields to the template form

features.name: Personalization of template forms
features.description: Users can personalize template forms to add fields like credit limit and sales person that are not visible by default in the template window.

features.name: Creating templates from existing customer cards
features.description: Users can create a template from an existing customer card by copying values they want to reuse for another customer.

features.name: Applying templates to existing customers
features.description: Templates can be applied to existing customers that were created before the template was available.

quotes.text: Classes are used to group similar customers together for reporting purposes. Classes also used to supply default settings when a new record is created.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose of classes in Dynamics SL as a comparison point to Business Central templates.
